title: The Single Row
subtitle: One continuous line, engineered so every stone stays facing forward.

stone.origin: Natural. Diamonds set in one continuous line, each stone calibrated to stay facing forward.

description: A necklace drawn as one continuous line of diamonds, each stone engineered against the flip so it stays facing forward around the whole curve of the neck — no stone turning to show its edge, no gap in the light. The Quadrillion, Bez Ambar's Princess cut, gives a bright squared face that sits flush against its neighbours, so the line reads as one unbroken run of brilliance rather than a string of separate stones. Made to fit the neck exactly, in eighteen-karat gold or platinum.
